column1: # Ground truth for `contour similar`, against the fixture corpus. This set is
# the one that runs in CI, so its job is to hold the harness honest — the
# corpus-scale judgements live in the rails, discourse and berater sets.
#   must      the neighbour must appear within the default limit; `tier` is
#             the tier expected to find it (structural | near_structural |
#   must_not  with a tier: must not appear at that tier or stronger; without:

# so the structural tier owes an answer without any embedder in the loop.

# be *reported* — it is a real neighbour — but never claimed as the same
